items.title: Frank Strazzeri interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: The interviewee discusses a musician who died young (implied to be Vince Guaraldi based on 'Cast Your Fate to the Wind' and Charlie Brown reference) but does not mention any personal interaction or relationship with Charlie Brown himself.

ctx.x: Whoa. You talk about a success story. But success is a strange thing. I mean can you imagine how successful he would have been today? He died very young. He died about 47 years old. He died in a hotel outside the airport in San Francisco. He checked in there because he was so busy, he lived in the San Francisco area but he was too busy to go home, so he just checked into a hotel, and they found him, he’d had a heart attack that night. He passed away.
He had a distinctive style to his tunes too, I’ve even noticed some similarity between like “Cast Your Fate to the Wind” and the thing he did for Charlie Brown.
